# truenas_nvmet_port_subsys (Resource)

Manages an NVMe-oF port/subsystem association (which subsystems are advertised on a port) on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_nvmet_port_subsys" "expose" {
  port_id   = 1
  subsys_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port_id` (Number) ID of the NVMe-oF port to associate.
- `subsys_id` (Number) ID of the NVMe-oF subsystem to associate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric NVMe-oF port/subsystem association ID assigned by TrueNAS.
